name: Borc
source:
"Who is that!"

Stands at the top of "Pistole Magier" and is the twin brother of Hardt.

He has a short temper. He's looking for a strong player who has a war-like personality that can compete with him.

[Translated from [url=https://blulunetta.web.fc2.com/pistole/story.html#borc]official website[/url]]
